name: tex
description: ClaudeTex typesets LaTeX math in Claude Code replies as Unicode text in the terminal, and opens a KaTeX browser preview of the same reply.

inline.title: Typeset inline math
inline.description: Convert $...$ and \(...\) in replies to Unicode math.

display.title: Typeset display math
display.description: Lay out $$...$$ and \[...\] as multi-line Unicode formulas.

teach_claude.title: Tell Claude to write LaTeX
teach_claude.description: Add a short note to the first prompt of each context window so Claude writes formulas as LaTeX instead of Unicode or ASCII.

max_width.title: Maximum display width
max_width.description: Widest display formula in terminal cells. 0 uses the terminal width.
